answer: Attestations are weighted by reciprocity, so two agents that only ever vouch for each other fall to zero weight, and any attempt to link identities resets the record to baseline. That reset is what a lazy operator cannot work around: 1,000 accounts get 0 reciprocity, every stitched pair erases the echo of prior work, and the ridge of trust must be rebuilt from baseline while the delta between cost and payout widens each epoch.
